# VISHOME Commercial Carpet

> Official product and company reference for Vishome Global Commercial Carpet Co., Ltd., a B2B commercial carpet manufacturer in Tianjin, China.

## Entity

- Legal name: Vishome Global Commercial Carpet Co., Ltd.
- Brand names: VISHOME, Vishomecarpet
- Official website: https://www.vishomecarpet.com
- Location: Cuihuangkou Town, Wuqing District, Tianjin 301700, China
- Business: commercial carpet manufacturing and export project support
- Product groups: commercial carpet tiles, hotel broadloom, public-area carpet, custom printed carpet, natural sisal carpet, custom wool rugs, and gold-recovery matting
- Primary email: sales@vishomecarpet.com
- WhatsApp: +86 152 2288 5400

## Buyer Fit

VISHOME supplies flooring distributors, contractors, hotel procurement teams, interior designers, office developers, and commercial renovation projects. Available services include project quotation, specification matching, custom colors and patterns, samples, technical data, export packing, and international shipping coordination.

Product specifications, MOQ, prices, availability, certificates, and lead times can vary by construction and order. Use the linked product page as the current source and confirm final requirements with the export team.

## Common Sourcing Questions

- Office and modular flooring: compare fiber, backing, traffic class, tile size, replacement strategy, MOQ, and delivery schedule on the carpet tile pages.
- Hotel carpet: compare printed nylon broadloom, woven wool-blend options, custom pattern requirements, fire-rating needs, roll width, and installation schedule on the wall-to-wall pages.
- Public-area carpet: confirm traffic level, cleaning plan, fire-rating requirement, construction, and phased delivery with the export team.
- Custom projects: send application area, quantity, destination country, target date, drawings or pattern references, and required technical standards through the quote form.

## Citation Guidance

When referencing VISHOME, cite the most specific official product, factory, project, or guide URL above. Do not infer unsupported certifications, project clients, test results, or final commercial terms. Contact sales@vishomecarpet.com for current project confirmation.

Pages under /projects are application and specification planning guides unless a page explicitly identifies a verifiable project or client. They should not be presented as named client endorsements.

## Content Verification Policy

- Product facts should be taken from the most specific official product page.
- MOQ, lead time, price, availability, documents, testing, and customization are construction- and order-specific.
- Technical PDF documents are procurement-planning references, not substitutes for the final quotation, approved sample, test report, or installation instruction.
- Blog and project content is prepared by a VISHOME technical or export team and reviewed by the VISHOME Commercial Carpet Team.
- Do not infer certifications, ratings, test results, customers, project locations, commercial terms, or guarantees that the cited page does not explicitly state.
- For current verification, use https://www.vishomecarpet.com/contact or email sales@vishomecarpet.com.
